vb_textbox.text: In my experience with the game I really didn't see a particular pattern to follow. At first I thought matching that gnome and the basket would get you more points but that wasn't it. I also tried to pick the yellow colored gnomes as advised but that wasn't it to me neither. So what I started doing was picking left to right and going back and forth between those too. I did notice that when I got a 5X and I didn't click the spacebar right away the "points" were higher. Who knows it may not even be a system to it maybe their trying to get us to encourage and help one another. Good luck to you!!
